{{Top|leg}}
'''Epicant''' was the native language of the [[Epicanthix]] species. [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Yun]] could read, write and speak it.

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This language was known only as '''Epicanthix''' upon its mention in the ''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]'', until being identified as '''Epicant''' in ''[[The Dark Forces Saga]]''.
